name: Nova
author: Erin Carter
description: A lone progenitor star near the frame edge brightens, flashes, and sheds one enormous ragged ring of light that sweeps across a sparse twinkling starfield and dissolves into the dark before the next rare eruption.

params.label: Nova period
params.effect: Seconds between shell sheddings; short values make eruptions frequent, long values make each one a rare event.

params.label: Ring width
params.effect: Thickness of the expanding shell in CSS pixels, from a knife-edge wavefront to a broad luminous band.

params.label: Filament
params.effect: FBM raggedness of the shell rim: 0 is a clean smooth ring, 1 a torn filamentary supernova remnant.
